source.text: Key point: Officer Wilson was not aware that #MikeBrown was a robbery suspect. It will be key in establishing his state of mind. #Ferguson

selection_rule: Strict explicit stance only where possible. Support means the comment accepts the source's point that Wilson not knowing about the robbery makes the robbery narrative irrelevant or weak for justifying the shooting. Oppose means the comment argues Brown's own knowledge/state of mind, the robbery call, or robbery-related facts remain relevant despite Wilson's alleged lack of awareness.
note: Selected 30 comments with balanced stances. This thread has fewer direct oppose comments; oppose comments were selected only when they still explicitly push back through Brown's state of mind, robbery-call relevance, or robbery-related context.
